description: The plot illustrates the model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios. The x-axis represents the percentage of activated parameters, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 300 million, labeled as "# Activate", and tick labels at intervals of 100 million, although the exact tick labels are not visible. The y-axis represents the Perplexity, with a linear scale ranging from approximately 11 to 14.5. There are six lines in the plot, each representing a different combination of sparsity settings for Attention and FFN components, with labels such as "MoH-100%ATTN-100%FFN", "MoH-100%ATTN-50%FFN", "MoH-50%ATTN-100%FFN", "MoH-50%ATTN-50%FFN", "MoH-25%ATTN-100%FFN", and "MoH-25%ATTN-25%FFN". The lines are distinguished by different colors, although the exact colors are not specified, and exhibit varying trends across the x-axis, with Perplexity values ranging from approximately 11.3 to 14.3; for example, the line for "MoH-100%ATTN-100%FFN" starts at around 289 million on the x-axis with a Perplexity of 11.43 and remains relatively stable, while the line for "MoH-25%ATTN-100%FFN" starts at around 213 million on the x-axis with a Perplexity of 14.31.
